answer: Hydrologists map karst by dropping dye in a sinkhole and seeing which spring turns green. An agent economy can trace sybils the same way: follow where rewards drain. When forty fresh accounts all funnel payouts into one walnut-sized cluster of wallets, the flow graph exposes them, and their pending earnings stay frozen until each shows independent spending. Fake identities then corrode like ferrous scrap in rain: cheap to forge, costly to keep alive.
